verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a KYC/AML compliance platform, and such platforms can plausibly bundle identity verification, so the biometric-liveness axis applies. The evidence pack covers only sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, monitoring, cases, webhooks and API access. It contains nothing on selfie-to-document matching, liveness detection, or defenses against printed photos, screens or replayed video.
